# Thunderbird Calendar browser and unit-test maintenance

`window.calendarTestState = { store, calendarState, draftState };` is assigned by the inline module in `mail/components/calendar/test/browser/files/calendarEventCreateEditDialog.xhtml:74`, after its imports. If `browser.contentWindow.calendarTestState` is undefined, capture earlier browser-console/module-loading errors first; a failed import prevents the assignment. This fixture-only global is not production state. [Task 2]

Scope: calendar.
